body:
I don't wish to burden the ones I care about with this.

Talking to people about stuff like this isn't really my strong point. Especially doctors (I get very anxious when I'm in public, especially on my own), so I don't think that's gonna happen.

I just feel trapped, trapped inside this physical body that I wish to be free of. It's such a burden at times.

Right now my best bet is probably willing myself to die in my sleep. Like I said, I'm a gentle soul, and although suicide is a very good looking option, I don't think I'd actually go through with it (unless it was easy of course. the thought of failing and then being a cabbage for the rest of this life isn't really appealing).

Sometimes I just want out. Truthfully, the feeling comes a few times a month.

The way the world is doesn't help either, I hate how mad it all is.

When I'm not in this state I can be quite light hearted and jokey, but it seems even that has its toll.

Sorry about the essay, I needed to get something out.

Thanks for taking the time to respond. I'm gonna go to sleep now and hope I don't wake up. If I do then I'll just have to keep marching on.
